open_region: No ATLAS/CMS (or LHCb) dedicated quirk search found. Open: colour-neutral EW-charged quirks with mQ >~180 GeV for Lambda ~0.3-30 keV (non-helical/coplanar-hit regime; Farina-Low recast gives no (1,1)_-1 bound at 1 keV); coloured quirks above ~0.5 TeV at Lambda>~1 keV. Ends of the proposed 0.1-100 keV band are partly covered (HSCP recast <300 eV; D0/FASER/monojet at tens of keV). Secondary: Wgamma/WZ resonance + displaced glueball vertex has no dedicated search; low-mass Wgamma (<300 GeV) outside CMS range. No ATLAS/CMS Phase-2 quirk projection exists.
